QuestInfo.name: The Entrance Trial
QuestInfo.0: Before you become a Cygnus Knight, Neinheart has something to tell you.
QuestInfo.1:
Neinheart says all aspiring Cygnus Knights have to pass the same basic trial.
Go west to the #b1st Drill Hall#k and bring back the #rProof of Training#k that the monsters have hidden there.
QuestInfo.2: You passed the Knighthood Trial. Now, your training to become the Knight of Light truly begins.
